# zedcloud_app_instance_snapshots (Data Source)

Lists the snapshots of an edge application instance, immediate and app-update ones.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the snapshots of an edge app instance, immediate and app-update ones.
data "zedcloud_app_instance_snapshots" "app" {
  app_instance_id = zedcloud_application_instance.app.id
}

output "snapshot_names" {
  value = data.zedcloud_app_instance_snapshots.app.snapshots[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_instance_id` (String) ID of the edge application instance.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only return the snapshot with this name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `snapshots` (List of Object) The app instance's snapshots. The controller keeps at most one per app instance in practice. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snapshots))

<a id="nestedatt--snapshots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `snapshots`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `state` (String)
